title: Scan output: one record per file (DRAFT, to be agreed by Organizer, Extractor and Planner)
description: Produced by the agent inside the sandbox and consumed by the Electron app. Paths are relative to the scanned root and use forward slashes.

root.description: Absolute path of the scanned folder (as seen by the host).

id.description: Stable id, e.g. hash of path. Used by approve/reject.

class.description: Course code like CSCI575, or null if unknown.

proposed_name.description: New file name, or null to keep the name.

proposed_folder.description: Destination folder relative to root, or null for no move.

needs_user.description: True when the agent wants to ask the user instead of guessing (proposal example 4).

question.description: What to ask the user when needs_user is true.

summary.description: One-line summary (same as the SQLite index).

sources.description: Every file this item was found in, relative to root. Conflicts cite all sources (proposal example 5).

note.description: Why this date was chosen, e.g. which announcement overrode the syllabus.

approvedPlan.description: Sent from the app to the executor after the user reviews the plan.
